top_choice_rationale: Cărtărescu's Blinding and Solenoid support the strongest available case for a distinctive, densely patterned project in which memory, embodiment and visionary speculation form an expansive metaphysical architecture. Romanian linguistic texture and the full poetry corpus remain translation-mediated and incompletely covered, but the supplied evidence establishes exceptional imaginative reach and coherent formal ambition.
